title: Addendum 14: batch 3 of the redo programme (items 3-1 to 3-3); items 3-4 and 3-5 are not run
written: 2026-11-06 ~04:30 EST (exact time = sha256 file mtime and git)
approved_by_user: user messages 2026-11-05/06: item 10 runs on target + control (6,841 papers) with logit lens and public J-lens only, L41-L47 and L49 first, L0-L23 after, L24 and L48 reproduction as hard checks; Stage 8 W GPU re-run NOT done (decision (b) after the CPU proxy C-2), so 3-4 and the dependent 3-5 are not run; 7.1B completion on the fast path is in the master queue.

general rules: as addendum 10 (tiny test, one real shard, rest; HARD reproduction checks; jobs <= 45 min; team-cluster bootstrap; results to the user first). Batch 3 starts after batch 2 (afterany between batches, afterok within an item).

3-3 Stage 7.1B completion on the fast pa.report: the 7.1B estimands as planned in 07_1_stage7_1, labelled post hoc relative to the original Stage 7 analysis.
